title: Velo Client 1.3.1: exact export
summary: Exports that never lose a frame, names that really disappear, faster GPU encoding and a much easier way in for AI agents.

blocks.text: **Velo Client 1.3.1** makes Velo Rewind ready for real videos: exports that never lose a frame, names that really disappear, and a much easier way in for AI agents.

blocks.caption: Cancel or stop at any time, the video only shows the world.

items: Exports now render **frame by frame**: every frame is in the video and the timing is exact, however long rendering takes. No more videos that play too fast
Recorded voice chat stays **perfectly in sync**
Uses your **graphics card's encoder** (NVIDIA, AMD, Intel, Mac): much faster
**Cancel** or **Stop & keep** at any time, also with Esc
Pick the **system audio device and microphone** in the Velo Rewind settings
Hiding name tags now works on players too, including the **score line** under the name
Server **holograms** with ranks or money above a hidden player are left out
New: **Hide on everyone** in the World tab hides every name tag and name hologram in a clip
Camera follow no longer flies through walls and leaves
Clicking a player in the Players menu flies the camera to them
Players menu clicks no longer go through to the timeline
A complete, much clearer guide (AI.md and GET /) with every endpoint, recipes and errors
"self" as a follow target, a list of every player in a recording, entity filters, sound settings
Start a profile from the command line: --launch <profile>
A hidden game no longer captures the mouse on Windows
